description: Implementation of Heart Rate Service (HRS) for Bluetooth in Zephyr OS, including service declaration, notification handling, and callback registration.

methods.name: hrmc_ccc_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the Client Characteristic Configuration changes, enabling or disabling notifications.

methods.name: read_blsc
methods.description: Reads the Body Sensor Location characteristic value.

methods.name: hrs_init
methods.description: Initializes the Heart Rate Service, setting default values.

methods.name: bt_hrs_cb_register
methods.description: Registers a callback for Heart Rate Service events.

methods.name: bt_hrs_cb_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for Heart Rate Service events.

methods.name: bt_hrs_notify
methods.description: Sends a heart rate measurement notification.
